OR A.RESVE_DT <= NOW()) AND (A.EXPIRY_DT IS NULL OR A.EXPIRY_DT >= NOW())
AND A.BBS_ID IN
#{bid}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY CASE WHEN IFNULL(G.NTT_TY, IFNULL(A.NTT_TY, '')) = 'NOTICE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, IFNULL(A.GROUP_NO, A.NTT_SQ) ASC, IFNULL(A.ORDER_NO, 0) ASC, A.NTT_SQ ASC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN IFNULL(G.NTT_TY, IFNULL(A.NTT_TY, '')) = 'NOTICE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, IFNULL(A.GROUP_NO, A.NTT_SQ) DESC, IFNULL(A.ORDER_NO, 0) ASC, A.NTT_SQ DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

DATE_FORMAT(N.CREATION_DT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS creationDt , BB.LIKE_FL AS likeFl , CASE WHEN BB.LIKE_FL = 'Y' THEN ( CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CM_NTT_VOTE V WHERE V.NTT_SQ = N.NTT_SQ AND V.BBS_ID = N.BBS_ID AND V.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND V.VOTE_GB = 'L' AND V.MBRSH_SQ = CAST(#{mbrshSq} AS DECIMAL(30, 0)) ) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) ELSE NULL END AS myLikeFl , BB.DISLIKE_FL AS dislikeFl , BB.COMMENT_FL AS commentFl , BB.REPLY_FL AS replyFl , CASE WHEN BB.DISLIKE_FL = 'Y' THEN ( CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CM_NTT_VOTE V WHERE V.NTT_SQ = N.NTT_SQ AND V.BBS_ID = N.BBS_ID AND V.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND V.VOTE_GB = 'D' AND V.MBRSH_SQ = CAST(#{mbrshSq} AS DECIMAL(30, 0)) ) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) ELSE NULL END AS myDislikeFl , CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CM_NTT_FAVORITE F WHERE F.NTT_SQ = N.NTT_SQ AND F.BBS_ID = N.BBS_ID AND F.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND F.MBRSH_SQ = CAST(#{mbrshSq} AS DECIMAL(30, 0)) ) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS myFavoriteFl , CAST(U.FILE_SQ AS CHAR) AS profileFileSq , N.CREATION_ID AS creationId , CASE WHEN IFNULL(N.NTT_TY, '') = 'NOTICE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS noticeYn , IFNULL(N.NTT_STTUS, 'PUBLIC') AS nttSttus , IFNULL(N.TITLE, '') AS titlePlain , CAST(N.CATEGORY_SQ AS CHAR) AS categorySq , DATE_FORMAT(N.RESVE_DT, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS ntceBgnde , DATE_FORMAT(N.EXPIRY_DT, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS ntceEndde FROM CM_NTT N INNER JOIN CM_BBS BB ON BB.BBS_ID = N.BBS_ID AND BB.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD LEFT JOIN CM_USER U ON U.USER_ID = N.CREATION_ID LEFT JOIN CM_BBS_CATEGORY C ON C.BBS_ID = N.BBS_ID AND C.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND C.CATEGORY_SQ = N.CATEGORY_SQ WHERE N.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND N.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND N.NTT_SQ = CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30, 0)) AND N.DELETE_FL = 'N' AND IFNULL(N.USE_FL, 'Y') = 'Y' LIMIT 1

mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO CM_NTT_VIEW (NTT_SQ, BBS_ID, CMPNY_CD, MBRSH_SQ) SELECT CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)), #{bbsId}, #{cmpnyCd}, M.MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH M INNER JOIN CM_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1

INSERT IGNORE INTO CM_NTT_FAVORITE (NTT_SQ, BBS_ID, CMPNY_CD, MBRSH_SQ) SELECT CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)), #{bbsId}, #{cmpnyCd}, M.MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH M INNER JOIN CM_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(T.COMMENT_SQ AS CHAR) AS commentSq , CAST(T.NTT_SQ AS CHAR) AS nttSq , T.BBS_ID AS bbsId , T.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , NULL AS parentCommentSq , CASE WHEN IFNULL(T.COMMENT, '') = '삭제된 글입니다.' THEN '삭제된 글입니다.' WHEN IFNULL(T.SECRET_FL, 'N') = 'Y' AND IFNULL(T.CREATION_ID, '') != #{userId} AND #{userId} != ( SELECT N.CREATION_ID FROM CM_NTT N WHERE N.NTT_SQ = T.NTT_SQ AND N.BBS_ID = T.BBS_ID AND N.CMPNY_CD = T.CMPNY_CD LIMIT 1 ) THEN '비밀글 댓글입니다.' ELSE T.COMMENT END AS comment , IFNULL(T.SECRET_FL, 'N') AS secretFl , 'N' AS noticeFl , DATE_FORMAT(T.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creationDt , T.CREATION_ID AS userId , CASE WHEN #{userId} = IFNULL(T.CREATION_ID, '') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS myCommentFl , CASE WHEN #{userId} = IFNULL(T.CREATION_ID, '') THEN IFNULL(U.USER_NM, '') ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(IFNULL(U.USER_NM, '익명'), 1), REPEAT('*', GREATEST(CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(U.USER_NM, '익명')) - 1, 0))) END AS userNm , IFNULL(T.DEPTH, 0) AS threadDepth FROM CM_NTT_COMMENT T LEFT JOIN CM_USER U ON U.USER_ID = T.CREATION_ID WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND T.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND T.NTT_SQ = CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND IFNULL(T.APPROVED_FL, 'Y') = 'Y' AND IFNULL(T.USE_FL, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY IFNULL(T.GROUP_NO, T.COMMENT_SQ) DESC, IFNULL(T.ORDER_NO, 0) ASC, T.COMMENT_SQ ASC

SELECT IFNULL(SECRET_FL, 'N') FROM CM_NTT_COMMENT WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND NTT_SQ = CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND COMMENT_SQ = CAST(#{commentSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND IFNULL(USE_FL, 'Y') = 'Y' LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(GROUP_NO AS CHAR) AS groupNo , IFNULL(ORDER_NO, 0) AS orderNo , IFNULL(DEPTH, 0) AS depth FROM CM_NTT_COMMENT WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND NTT_SQ = CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND COMMENT_SQ = CAST(#{commentSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND IFNULL(USE_FL, 'Y') = 'Y' LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(MAX(IFNULL(ORDER_NO, 0)), 0) FROM CM_NTT_COMMENT WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND NTT_SQ = CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND GROUP_NO = CAST(#{groupNo} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND IFNULL(USE_FL, 'Y') = 'Y'
